title: Davide: Conviction rate must be based on senators qualified to vote

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Former Supreme Court Chief Justice Hilario Davide Jr. said the votes needed to convict in an impeachment trial should be based on the number of senators qualified to vote, “not the 24 in the present Senate.” Davide gave this opinion through a memorandum dated September 14 emailed to the Senate impeachment court, where Vice President Sara Dutere’s impeachment trial is ongoing. He was among the four retired justices of the high court invited as amici curiae to give their views on whether the 16-vote threshold should be retained.
